response.incident_summary: Between 12:02:46.989849Z and 12:02:48.494213Z, the checkout-service in the checkout namespace on demo-cluster experienced a sharp increase in HTTP 503 errors (ev_alert_001) and payment dependency failures (ev_log_template_003, ev_metric_006), with a 1000% rise in error rate (ev_metric_003) and over 1496% increase in p95 latency (ev_metric_004). The alert explicitly attributes the failures to a synthetic payment dependency failure (ev_alert_001), and log analysis reveals 40 instances of 'Payment dependency <IP> unavailable after <NUM> retries' (ev_log_template_003).

primary_hypothesis.claim: The checkout service errors are most likely caused by a failure of the synthetic payment dependency, as described in the alert and confirmed by log and metric anomalies. Further investigation should focus on whether the failure was triggered by a configuration change ('Failure mode changed enabled=true', ev_log_template_004) or an upstream outage.

domain_reasoning.fault_events: The single alert (ev_alert_001) defines the incident trigger and explicitly states a synthetic payment dependency failure caused HTTP 503 responses, providing the core narrative.
domain_reasoning.log_text: Log template ev_log_template_003 ('Payment dependency <IP> unavailable after <NUM> retries') appears 40 times (28.4% of case logs) starting at 12:02:47.026063Z, directly before and coincident with the alert.
